blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Bam Aquino on Friday denounced the mocking of persons with disabilities after hosts of the “Machong Chismisan” podcast made disrespectful remarks against his nephew, Joshua “Josh” Aquino, who is on the autism spectrum. “The real macho does not look down on persons with disabilities,” Aquino said in an interview at the Senate. His remarks came after podcast host Tito Patrioto, known as “Tito P,” described Josh as “walang kwenta” during an episode, prompting the other four hosts to laugh. “Josh, Bimby, they’re very nice people.
